reports.title: Trimble Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results and Updates Full Year Guidance

lines: For the full-year 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $3,910 million and $3,940 million, GAAP loss per share of $0.55 to $0.49, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.63 to $3.69.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $1,031 million and $1,061 million, GAAP earnings per share of $0.83 to $0.89, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $1.13 to $1.19.
